name: E-Thela Sahaayata Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "E-Thela Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 19 June 2017.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;E-Thela Sahaayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on 19 June 2017. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance for e-thela.
benefitsMd:
1. Registered unorganized labor individuals will need to cover the expenses of ₹ 10,000 for scheme execution.
1. A grant of ₹ 30,000/- will be provided by the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Worker State Social Security Board.
1. The remaining sum will be extended to the Rikshaw/Auto Driver as a bank loan, with the beneficiary responsible for repaying it within a specified timeframe and at the interest rate determined by the bank.
1. The Board will only transfer its contribution to the beneficiary's account once all the necessary loan-related documents are submitted to the board.
eligibilityMd:
1. Unorganized workers registered under the State Social Security Board and running hand carts are eligible for the scheme.
1. Registered workers must be between the ages of 18 and 50.
1. Commercial vehicle drivers must have a health certificate from the RTO.
1. Registered workers must be registered with the Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board for at least 90 days.
1. Each worker is only eligible for the scheme once.
exclusionsMd: > Workers who are receiving benefits from any other parallel scheme of the State Government are not eligible for this scheme.
